title: Cloud, AWS & Infrastructure Professional Program
description: Master cloud computing fundamentals and advanced practices with AWS: design, deploy and operate scalable applications in the cloud. Covers key technologies such as Terraform, Docker and Kubernetes, with hands-on exercises and a real final project. Includes 16 weeks of structured content, live mentoring and access to a real AWS account to apply what you learn.

title: Extension for Google Chrome to manage bookmarks
description: Google Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) designed to replace the traditional bookmarks bar with a single minimalist popup launcher. It includes a bookmark auditing engine that scans for obsolete, broken, or mismatched URLs and provides an interactive dashboard to manage and clean them up.
